## `Core/Utilities/ChoiceList.h`

Selectable value lists for settings screens (scheme, FPS limit, language ...): reading saved values and stepping.

- `template<class T, std::size_t N> constexpr T StoredChoice(std::int64_t stored, const std::array<T, N>& choices, T fallback)` — Option matching the raw saved value; 'fallback' if absent from the list.
- `template<class T, std::size_t N> constexpr T StepChoice(T current, const std::array<T, N>& choices, int steps)` — Moves 'steps' options from 'current' (negative: backward), wrapping at both ends; starts at the first if absent.
- `template<class T> constexpr T StepChoice(T current, std::span<const T> choices, int steps)` — For lists filtered at runtime (e.g. window sizes fitting the monitor); returns 'current' for an empty list.
